skill_data.name: Light-First Landscape Observation
skill_data.description: Prioritize light assessment before selecting subject and composition in landscape photography.
skill_data.description_zh: 在风光摄影中，先评估光线条件（如晨昏柔光、阴天漫射光），再确定主体与构图；强调慢观察、做减法、尊重自然，并通过持续实践形成个人视角。

rules.condition: Golden hour (sunrise/sunset) is approaching or ongoing
rules.condition_zh: 日出或日落的黄金时刻正在来临或进行中
rules.action: Position yourself to capture side/back lighting, emphasize texture and depth with long shadows
rules.action_zh: 选择侧光或逆光位，利用长阴影突出景物纹理与空间层次
rules.reason: 此时光线柔和、色温温暖、明暗对比丰富，能极大增强画面立体感与情绪感染力

rules.action: Focus on fine details, textures, and subtle tonal gradations; avoid high-contrast subjects
rules.action_zh: 聚焦细节、质感与细腻影调过渡；避免依赖强对比的题材
rules.reason: 漫射光减少硬阴影，适合表现静谧氛围与微小结构，如苔藓、水面涟漪、雾中轮廓

rules.condition: Scene appears cluttered or visually overwhelming
rules.condition_zh: 画面元素杂乱、视觉信息过载
rules.action: Apply compositional subtraction: remove non-essential elements, use foreground as visual guide
rules.action_zh: 执行构图减法：剔除非必要元素，利用前景引导视线至主体
rules.reason: 简化构图可提升视觉焦点清晰度，避免观众注意力分散

rules.condition: Natural elements (wind, water, clouds) show dynamic movement
rules.condition_zh: 风、水、云等自然元素呈现动态变化
rules.action: Pause, observe rhythm, and wait for the decisive moment of harmony or contrast
rules.action_zh: 暂停拍摄，观察运动节奏，等待和谐或戏剧性瞬间出现
rules.reason: 自然动态是风光摄影的灵魂，耐心等待能捕捉到不可复制的瞬时美感

rules.condition: Photographer feels urge to alter environment (e.g., move rocks, trample vegetation)
rules.condition_zh: 摄影师产生改变环境的冲动（如搬动石块、踩踏植被）
rules.action: Refrain from any interference; seek alternative angles or compositions instead
rules.action_zh: 克制干预行为，转而寻找替代角度或构图方案
rules.reason: 尊重自然生态是职业伦理底线，真实、未被干扰的场景更具长期价值与艺术真诚性
